summary: Phase 3 Admin Console — full backend + frontend E2E. 27/27 new admin backend tests PASS + 36/36 regression from iteration_2 PASS (63/63 total). Frontend admin console verified end-to-end: login (with wrong-pw error), JWT stored in localStorage 'hariram_admin_token', dashboard stats, products table (4 rows), shipping JSON editor with inline invalid-JSON error, pending orders (22 rows, sort field + direction toggle, per-row Invoice button triggers POST /send-invoice -> 200), completed orders default date range (today-30d -> today), unauth /admin redirects to /admin/login.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_orders.export_completed_xlsx and export_completed_pdf call list_completed(..., {'sub':'admin'}) — passing a fake admin dict bypasses the Depends chain. Works because require_admin is only enforced on the outer route, but the pattern is fragile: if list_completed later gains admin-scoped logic (e.g., filter by admin), this shortcut will silently misbehave. Consider refactoring the shared query into a helper function that doesn't take the admin arg at all.
admin_shipping.upload validates only presence of 'rules' and 'defaultCharge'; doesn't validate rules is a list (unlike PUT). Small inconsistency.

admin_products.upload_image reads full file into memory then checks size — a 100MB upload would still buffer entirely before rejection. For a small-scale admin this is fine, but consider streaming/max_upload_size at the ASGI layer for hardening.
server.py mounts /api/uploads AFTER app.include_router(api) is called twice — works, but the double include_router (line 390 and 404) is redundant. FastAPI dedups but it is a code smell.
AdminShippingPage inline error div uses inline style, no .error class. Not a bug — but adding class='admin-error' would help testing/observability.
